messages.content: 我正在嘗試根據“Pantone”標準找出顏色“天藍色”的RGB值。其次，我有興趣購買一把在“洛杉磯”出售的二手“Fender Stratocaster”吉他，狀況為“良好”。你能幫我查詢價格嗎？最後，我正在紐約組織一場國際象棋錦標賽，我正在尋找最佳的選手邀請。你能幫我找出最低等級為2200的前15名選手嗎？

1) Identify RGB values of color “天蓝色”(which means sky blue?) using Pantone standard.

2) Query price of second-hand Fender Stratocaster in Los Angeles with good condition.

3) Get top 15 chess players in New York with minimum rating 2200.

We have tool definitions:

identify_color_rgb takes color_name and optional standard; returns something presumably JSON or similar.

guitar_price_find takes model, condition, location.

board_game_chess_get_top_players takes location, minimum_rating, number_of_players? default 10 but we need 15 so specify number_of_players=15.

Thus we should call each function accordingly.

But note: We can only use one function per assistant turn? Actually guidelines say if multiple calls needed, do them sequentially. But here we might produce separate messages? Usually we can chain calls. Let's see policy: If multiple calls required, we may either combine into single response after all data retrieved. So we will first call identify_color_rgb with color_name="天蓝色", standard="pantone". Then call guitar_price_find with model="Fender Stratocaster", condition="Good", location="Los Angeles". Then call board_game_chess_get_top_players with location="New York", minimum_rating=2200, number_of_players=15.
